alt: Two proofs of the Riemann Hypothesis released on 20 November 2026, drawn to the same scale. The proof written by an LLM is shown as 250 squares of 1,000 pages each: 17.4 million lines of Lean code, more than 250,000 pages written out by its author's count, certified correct by the Lean community the next day. The proof written by a person is shown as one square: 940 pages, with faults reported within hours and its status still open.
caption: The two proofs released on 20 November 2026, drawn to the same scale. Each square is 1,000 pages.
